よう、ミリアム。今日は何をやってるんだ？: Hey, Miriam. What are you up to today?
対戦ゲームだよ！ 今、大火力で突撃してるところ！\n……ああああ！ 撃墜された～:
A versus game! I'm charging in with tons of firepower!
...Aaaah! I got shot down~?!
……ミリアム、わかりやすく火力特化が好きだよな。\nコスプレで魔導士を選んだのも:
...Miriam, you really do love going all-in on firepower.
Is that why you chose to cosplay as a mage too?
そうだよー！ やっぱり、でっかい火力でどかーん！\n分かりやすいし、決めたら最高:
Yep! Nothing beats huge firepower and a big BOOM!
Nice and simple, and it feels amazing when you land it!
だから、ボクは対戦ゲームとか『コスモファンタジア』でも、\n火力が一番出る組み合:
So in versus games and Cosmo Fantasia,
I'm always trying different setups for maximum firepower... Ah! Shot down again?!
（……ミリアムはロマンを求めて、スコアとか悪くするタイプだな）: (...Miriam's the type to chase that big, flashy moment even if it hurts her score.)
そういうところは長所だな。自分がやりたい事を通すために、\n拘れるのはパイロット:
That's a strength too. Having the dedication
to see your own ideas through matters for a pilot as well.
えっ？ そうなの？ それじゃあ、ボクのＭＧにも、\n火力をたくさん積んで最強の機:
Huh? Really? Then can I load my MG up
with tons of firepower and make it the strongest machine ever?
……すまん、前言撤回してもいいか？ それはやりすぎだ。: ...Sorry, can I take that back? That's going too far.
やっぱり？ ゲームだからやりたいことをするけど、\n一番楽しいのはチームで勝つこ:
Thought so! I do what I want in games,
but winning as a team is the most fun, so that comes first~.
あっ！ やった！ 決まったー！ 見てみて！\nほら、ボクの一撃で相手の陣形が総崩:
Oh! Yes! Nailed it! Look, look!
See? That one hit broke their whole formation!
おお、たしかにこれを見たら癖になるな。: Oh, yeah. Seeing that, I can understand why it's addictive.
……ある意味ではブレず、大切なものを間違えないミリアム。\n俺が思う以上に大物か:
...In her own way, Miriam stayed true to herself without losing sight of what mattered.
I thought she might have more potential than I'd given her credit for.
そうだな。ロマンはいいが、実戦では基本を忠実にするんだぞ？: Yeah. Those big moments are great, but stick to the basics in real combat, okay?
うん、分かってるよー！\n実践は、ちゃんとみんなと勝つために合わせてるからね！:
Yeah, I know~!
In real combat, I work with everyone so we can win together!
すまんすまん、ロマンを押し通すだけの実力があればいいが、\nミリアムにはまだ早い:
Sorry, sorry. If you've got the skill to make those big ideas work, that's fine.
But you're not quite there yet, Miriam, so I couldn't help saying something.
むむむ……それなら、もっと練習して強くなる！\nボクの一撃で敵をバッタバッタとな:
Hmm... Then I'll practice more and get stronger!
Wiping out enemies one after another with one big hit... That's the dream!
ああ、その気合は大切だぞ。\n適度に息抜きをしながら頑張れ。:
Yeah. That enthusiasm matters.
Keep at it, and take a breather now and then.
俺の言葉にやる気が出たのか、ゲームはそこそこに、\n訓練に行ってくると元気よく帰:
Maybe my words had fired her up. Miriam cut her gaming short
and cheerfully headed off, saying she was going to train.
